feature: Add Mobile Navigation Menu to Landing Page
workflow_rationale: Single file modification for a frontend-only UI enhancement. No backend changes, no multi-service coordination needed. The task adds a hamburger menu and mobile navigation drawer to improve mobile UX.

phases.name: Mobile Navigation Implementation
phases.description: Add hamburger menu button and slide-out navigation drawer for mobile viewports

subtasks.description: Extract page content to client component and add mobile menu state

verification.command: grep -q "'use client'" app/page-client.tsx && grep -q "useState" app/page-client.tsx && echo "OK" || echo "FAIL"

subtasks.notes: Successfully extracted page content to client component (app/page-client.tsx) with 'use client' directive. Added useState hook for mobileMenuOpen state. Updated app/page.tsx to import and render the client component while keeping metadata export in server component.

subtasks.description: Update Navigation component to accept mobile menu props
subtasks.notes: Successfully updated Navigation component to accept onMenuClick prop. Replaced mobile 'Başla' button with a hamburger menu icon button that calls the onMenuClick handler. Updated HomePageClient to pass onMenuClick={() => setMobileMenuOpen(true)} to Navigation. Verification passed.

subtasks.description: Add mobile menu drawer with backdrop and navigation links
subtasks.notes: Successfully added mobile menu drawer with backdrop and navigation links. The drawer slides in from the right using translate-x-0/translate-x-full animations. Includes: (1) backdrop overlay with click-to-close, (2) slide-in drawer from right, (3) navigation links (Özellikler, Fiyatlandırma, Giriş Yap), (4) close button, (5) Ücretsiz Dene CTA button at bottom, (6) all links close the menu on click. Verification passed.

checks: Hamburger menu button visible on mobile viewport (<768px)
Desktop nav links still visible on desktop (>=768px)
Mobile menu drawer slides in when hamburger clicked
All navigation links present in mobile menu

subtasks.notes: Mobile navigation implementation is complete and ready for manual browser testing. Cannot start dev server due to permission restrictions. Comprehensive testing instructions documented in build-progress.txt. Implementation includes: (1) hamburger menu button visible on mobile (<768px), (2) desktop nav links visible on desktop (≥768px), (3) slide-in drawer from right, (4) backdrop overlay, (5) all navigation links in mobile menu, (6) menu closes on backdrop click, (7) menu closes on link click, (8) smooth animations. Manual verification required: start dev server with 'npm run dev', open http://localhost:3000, test all responsive breakpoints and interactions, verify no console errors.

acceptance_criteria: Mobile hamburger menu button visible on viewports <768px
Mobile menu drawer slides in smoothly with backdrop
All navigation links accessible in mobile menu
Menu closes on backdrop click and link click

verification_steps.name: Dev Server Start
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Server starts on port 3000 without errors

verification_steps.name: Browser Visual Test
verification_steps.expected_outcome: Mobile menu works correctly in responsive view

verification_strategy.reasoning: Low risk UI-only change. No tests required for simple navigation enhancement. Manual browser testing sufficient to verify functionality.

qa_signoff.notes: All code-level quality checks passed. Implementation follows React best practices, TypeScript is properly typed, security review clean, accessibility attributes present. Manual browser testing recommended but non-blocking.
qa_signoff.manual_testing_notes: Dev server could not be started due to npm/npx restrictions. Visual verification and browser testing recommended after merge.
